deviceCapability.field: heartReader: present | absent (proposed into the item's #31 record, beside the snag class flag)
deviceCapability.strippedGear: Syndicate-class devices carry no reader; a throw made with a stripped device at a closed heart prompts as theft or not at all, and the record scores the throw as the taking it was — the ledger judges the act, not the tool
deviceCapability.tell: the absence is a staged fact: a device that cannot see hearts cannot hesitate — the show's audience learns to read the missing beat (#276's grammar rests on this)

note: One mechanism, two moral shapes; the heart read decides which one the player is standing in. The throw math is #268's in both shapes — only the vocabulary switches.

promptShape.content: the device FIRST states the fact it sees (the heart is closed — gauge band, never fake-precise, per #287), THEN asks the rescue question
promptShape.familyShape: #347's: one question, two answers; NO is free and writes nothing; the closure fact is shown as part of the asking, not held as a reward for YES
promptShape.strings: #23 string data; shape fixed here, final wording is writing in the owner's register

shapeSelection.input: #287's heart record, read by the device's own function (#149 identify class — no new class founded)
shapeSelection.rule: the target's state alone chooses the prompt class; player intent is never consulted

writes.morale: NO ledger entry, ever — a rescue row in #269's ledger is a landing defect
writes.onConfirmedFailure: the item is consumed; nothing moral, legal, or reputational is written — rescue attempts are outside #348's attempt class (no completed dark deed exists for them to attempt)
writes.onConfirmedSuccess: no theft entry; keeping opens as #288's purification road with the true keeper citation untouched; custody per #245/#220 where the rescue is a service act
writes.rescueCredit: none at the throw — downstream completions score in their own rows (#288 opening, #273 recovery, #275 restitution)
